metadata.title: Consider a Used EV if You Want to Buy a Luxury Car<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
A Used EV Is the Way to Get Those Luxury Wheels
Chris Blaydon was used-car shopping for his teenage daughter this summer. Then he and his wife discovered lightly used, higher-end electric vehicles were selling for nearly half of their original sticker price.
